title: baseline
description: Seasonal reference stats for z — per-ticker per-resolution rolling means/stds keyed by bucket_scheme and seasonal_bucket. See data-dictionary.md §6 and data-model.md §5.4.

ticker.description: The instrument. Every ticker must exist in instrument.

resolution.description: Which rollup resolution these baselines serve.

bucket_scheme.description: Seasonality scheme chosen per resolution for warmup speed: 1h→hour_of_week (168), 15m→time_of_day (96, drops day-of-week to warm in days), 1d→day_of_week (7).

seasonal_bucket.description: The recurring calendar slot index within the bucket_scheme (e.g. Mon 00:00 UTC = 0 for hour_of_week).

mention_mean.description: Trailing mean of mentions for this slot — μ in z.

mention_std.description: Trailing standard deviation of mentions for this slot — σ in z.

sample_count.description: Number of observations in this slot — gates status (ready at ≥ min_samples_ready).

status.description: Per-slot readiness: cold → warming → ready. Mirrors empirical_feature.baseline_status.

vol_mean.description: Market analog: average volume for this slot — basis for rvol's denominator.

updated_at.description: When this row was last rolling-recomputed.
